name: Doorman
author: xaiovz
description: See who joins and leaves the local network you are on, with a bar counter, a device list, and notifications.

barWidget.description: Devices on the current network: who is online, who was seen before, and recent joins and leaves.

schema.label: Absence before "left" (seconds)
schema.description: Phones sleep their Wi-Fi; a device must be missing this long to count as gone.

schema.label: Active ping sweep
schema.description: Ping every address of the local /24 each scan so sleeping devices show up. Off = only devices the computer already talks to.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: all = every join and leave; new = only devices never seen before; off = none.
